name: Chart
description: Bar, line, area, pie or doughnut chart of static data, another field's rows, lookup results or a saved report. Keyboard-navigable points, a data table view, and optional point selection.

props.name: chart_title
props.label: Chart title
props.description: Shown above the chart and used as the data table's caption.

options.label: Another field (map the Data context entry)
Lookup source (set the field's lookup, Min characters 0)

props.name: report_id
props.label: Saved report
props.description: For Saved report: the report's id (open it in Reports — the id is in the address bar). People see only what they can see in Reports.

props.name: lookup_query
props.label: Lookup query
props.description: For Lookup source: the search text sent to the lookup (empty = everything).

props.name: label_field
props.label: Label field
props.description: The row field (or report column key) for the labels. Defaults to the first text field.

props.name: value_field
props.label: Value field
props.description: The row field for the values. Defaults to the first numeric field.

props.name: series_fields
props.label: Series fields
props.description: Several numeric fields, one series each (instead of Value field).

props.name: show_legend
props.label: Show legend
props.description: Shown for pie / doughnut charts and when there is more than one series.

props.name: colors
props.label: Colours
props.description: Series / slice colours (#hex). Defaults to the theme's primary colour plus accessible companions for light and dark mode.

props.name: selectable
props.label: Selectable points
props.description: Clicking a point (or Enter on it) makes it the field's value: { label, value, series }.

context.name: data
context.label: Data
context.description: For 'Another field': a field whose value is a list of rows, such as an editable table. Label field / Value field pick the columns.

output.description: The label of the point picked (Selectable points); <key>_value is its number, <key>_series its series

accessibility.keyboard: Tab to the chart; Left / Right move through the points (Up / Down change series), Home / End jump to the first / last, Enter selects the point when points are selectable, Escape leaves the point. The 'Show data table' button shows every value in a table.

author: UserTasks
